last_run: Weekly upgrade. The smarter pick-ranker is switched on again and is now choosing the top pick people see. Its tests are all on practice calls, where its edge has been shrinking over time, and until now it got no check on real calls made in real time. I added one: once about 300 real calls have 30-day results (early December), the ranker switches itself off if its picks are doing worse than the app's own picks on them. Nothing changes before then, and no safety check was loosened.
working_on: Making sure the pick-ranker that users see is backed by real-time results, not only practice data.
next: Early December: check the first real-time comparison (about 300 calls) and whether the ranker stays on.
